name: Generalized Anxiety & Chronic Worry
core_symptoms: Persistent uncontrollable worry
Restlessness and muscle tension
Fatigue and irritability
Sleep onset disturbance
cognitive_distortions: Catastrophizing
Probability Overestimation

solutions.cbt_reframing: Identify the worst-case scenario and calculate its realistic statistical probability. Shift from 'What if?' to 'What is true right now?'
solutions.somatic_anchor: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding: Name 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, and 1 you taste to disengage amygdala hijack.
solutions.pranayama: Nadi Shodhana (Alternate Nostril Breathing) for 5 minutes to restore autonomic parasympathetic tone and lower sympathetic surge.
solutions.micro_habit: Schedule a dedicated 15-minute 'Worry Window' at 4:30 PM. When worry strikes outside this window, mentally file it away until then.

name: Nervous Exhaustion & Clinical Burnout
core_symptoms: Emotional exhaustion and cynicism
Depersonalization toward work or caregiving
Sense of inefficacy and severe brain fog
Physical lethargy unrefreshed by sleep
cognitive_distortions: Overextension / All-or-Nothing Responsibility
Guilt around resting

solutions.cbt_reframing: Reframe rest as non-negotiable physiological maintenance rather than an earned reward. You cannot pour from an empty cup.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Somatic Release: Lie flat, unglue your tongue from the roof of your mouth, drop your shoulders away from your ears, and soften your pelvic floor.
solutions.pranayama: Bhramari (Humming Bee Breath) for 4 minutes to create cranial micro-vibrations that stimulate nitric oxide and vagus nerve tone.
solutions.micro_habit: Implement an absolute 'Digital Sunset' 60 minutes before bed with no professional notifications or blue light exposure.

name: Acute Panic & Autonomic Dysregulation
core_symptoms: Sudden heart palpitations and racing pulse
Hyperventilation or sensation of suffocation
Trembling, cold chills, or hot flashes
Derealization or acute fear of losing control
cognitive_distortions: Interoceptive Catastrophizing ('My heart is beating fast, therefore I am having a medical emergency')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Recognize this surge as a harmless adrenaline burst that naturally metabolizes and subsides within 8 to 12 minutes. Sensations are intense but safe.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Mammalian Dive Reflex: Press an ice pack or cold damp towel against your upper cheeks and eyes for 20 seconds to instantly slow down tachycardia.
solutions.pranayama: Extended Exhale Protocol: Inhale gently through nose for 4 seconds, then exhale smoothly through pursed lips for 7 seconds. Long exhales lower cardiac rate.
solutions.micro_habit: Repeat aloud: 'This is uncomfortable, but it is not dangerous. My nervous system is discharging energy and I am safe.'

name: Depressive Episode, Low Mood & Emotional Inertia
core_symptoms: Pervasive low mood and persistent sadness
Anhedonia (loss of interest or pleasure in all activities)
Severe avolition and physical heaviness
Feelings of worthlessness or excessive inappropriate guilt
cognitive_distortions: All-or-Nothing Thinking
Emotional Reasoning ('I feel hopeless, so everything must be futile')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Behavioral Activation Principle: Action precedes motivation, not the reverse. Do not wait to feel like doing something before initiating.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Somatic Activation: Stand barefoot on a firm surface, press down firmly through your heels, and gently tap your sternum with your fingertips for 60 seconds.
solutions.pranayama: Surya Bhedana (Right Nostril Breathing) or gentle Kapalabhati (Skull Shining Breath) for 3 minutes to energize the solar nadi and clear tamasic fog.
solutions.micro_habit: Micro-Task Stacking: Choose a task so laughably small that failure is impossible (e.g., washing a single cup or opening the window curtains).

name: Imposter Syndrome, Perfectionism & Fear of Failure
core_symptoms: Persistent fear of being exposed as an intellectual fraud
Compulsive over-preparation or chronic procrastination due to perfectionism
Inability to internalize and celebrate genuine achievements
Harsh inner critic and relentless self-flagellation
cognitive_distortions: Discounting the Positive
Mind-Reading ('Everyone thinks I don't belong here')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Cognitive Defusion: Reframe imposter feelings as evidence of operating at the edge of growth, rather than evidence of incompetence.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Self-Compassion Touch: Place your right hand warmly over your heart and left hand over your abdomen. Feel the steady warmth and say: 'I am learning and I belong.'
solutions.pranayama: Sitali Pranayama (Cooling Breath via curled tongue) for 3 minutes to cool cognitive overheating, perfectionist inflammation, and mental pitta.
solutions.micro_habit: Keep a 'Concrete Evidence Log': Write down 1 factual, objective piece of data confirming a contribution you made today.

name: Relational Conflict, Heartbreak & Attachment Distress
core_symptoms: Acute heartache or visceral heaviness in the chest
Obsessive mental rumination on relational interactions or breakups
Intense fear of abandonment or relational rejection
Emotional dysregulation following interpersonal conflict
cognitive_distortions: Personalization ('Their withdrawal means I am inherently unlovable')
Overgeneralization ('I will always end up alone')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Differentiate between your core self-worth and another person's emotional capacity. Rejection is often relational misalignment, not personal deficit.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Heart-Holding & Postural Recenter: Interlace your fingers behind your head, gently lean back into your hands, and allow your chest and collarbones to expand.
solutions.pranayama: Hridaya Heart-Centering Breath: Inhale deeply into the center of the chest for 5 seconds, hold for 2, and exhale with a soft audible sigh for 6 seconds.
solutions.micro_habit: Implement a 2-Hour Communication Pause: When triggered in a relationship, wait at least 120 minutes before sending any emotional reaction or text.

name: Chronic Loneliness, Alienation & Social Isolation
core_symptoms: Deep visceral ache of feeling unseen or disconnected from the world
Social withdrawal coupled with an intense craving for genuine intimacy
Existential questioning of meaning, belonging, and connection
Hyper-vigilance to perceived social rejection or disinterest
cognitive_distortions: Polarized Thinking ('Everyone else has community, I am uniquely isolated')
Mental Filter (filtering out small friendly social overtures)

solutions.cbt_reframing: Normalize loneliness as an evolutionary biological signal (like hunger or thirst) indicating a basic human need, not an immutable personality flaw.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Warmth Regulation: Hold a warm mug of tea with both hands, feel the radiating thermal sensation, and notice your contact with the ground.
solutions.pranayama: Metta (Loving-Kindness) Coherent Breathing: Inhale for 5 seconds offering goodwill to self; exhale for 5 seconds expanding goodwill outward.
solutions.micro_habit: Social Micro-Connection: Exchange a warm, genuine 10-second greeting or smile with one person today (a barista, neighbor, or peer).

name: Acute Anger, Irritability & Injustice Distress
core_symptoms: Flushing, clenched fists, jaw tension, and surging adrenaline
Violent or aggressive mental scripts and urgent desire to lash out
Intense irritability and low tolerance for minor frustrations
Obsessive fixation on unfairness, boundary violations, or betrayal
cognitive_distortions: Should Statements ('They should know better; this must not happen')
Blaming / Injustice Magnification

solutions.cbt_reframing: Distinguish between anger as a valid emotional boundary alarm and reactive behavior. The anger is informational; the explosive reaction is optional.
solutions.somatic_anchor: TIPP Progressive Muscle Clench-and-Release: Clench your fists and forearms with maximum force for 7 seconds, then suddenly drop and release completely on a heavy exhale.
solutions.pranayama: Sitkari Cooling Breath: Inhale through gently clenched teeth with parted lips, feeling the icy air cool your palate; exhale smoothly through the nose.
solutions.micro_habit: The 10-Count Sensory Interrupter: When boiling with rage, walk away immediately, drink a glass of cold water, and count backward from 10 before speaking.

name: Grief, Bereavement & Profound Emotional Loss
core_symptoms: Waves of acute sorrow and sudden spontaneous weeping
Profound physical exhaustion and feeling emotionally hollowed out
Disorientation, numbness, or disbelief following loss
Intense yearning and difficulty engaging with routine daily tasks
cognitive_distortions: Magical Thinking / Bargaining ('If only I had done something different')
Future Desolation ('I will never feel happiness again')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Grief is not a problem to be solved or cured; it is the natural, honorable expression of deep love with nowhere left to go. Give it holy space.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Gentle Butterfly Hug: Cross your arms over your chest with fingertips resting below your collarbones. Alternate gentle, slow tapping left and right like butterfly wings.
solutions.pranayama: Natural Diaphragmatic Breath: Place both hands over your navel. Breathe gently without forcing depth, allowing the abdomen to rise and fall naturally.
solutions.micro_habit: 5-Minute Grief Sanctuary: Dedicate 5 undisturbed minutes to look at a photo, light a candle, or cry freely without attempting to 'fix' the feeling.

name: Social Anxiety, Mind-Reading & Fear of Scrutiny
core_symptoms: Fear of humiliation, blushing, stammering, or shaking in front of others
Intense post-event cognitive autopsies analyzing every conversational turn
Avoidance of public speaking, meetings, or social gatherings
Excessive self-consciousness and inward focus during interactions
cognitive_distortions: Spotlight Effect ('Everyone is noticing my flaws and judging me')
Mind Reading ('They think I am awkward and boring')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Decentering & Spotlight Dimming: People are overwhelmingly preoccupied with their own insecurities. They are not scrutinizing you; you are safe to be ordinary.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Panoramic Vision Shift: Soften your gaze and expand your visual field to take in the peripheral edges of the room. This neurobiologically disarms social threat appraisal.
solutions.pranayama: 4-4-4-4 Box Breathing (Sama Vritti): Inhale 4s, hold 4s, exhale 4s, hold 4s to stabilize blood pressure and eliminate speech tremors.
solutions.micro_habit: Curiosity Pivot: In your next conversation, consciously redirect 80% of your attention toward genuine curiosity about the other person rather than monitoring yourself.

name: Executive Dysfunction, Procrastination Paralysis & ADHD Overload
core_symptoms: Task paralysis: Wanting desperately to begin a task but physically unable to start
Working memory overload and feeling overwhelmed by multi-step projects
Time blindness and sudden intense shame around missed deadlines
Dopamine depletion leading to compulsive phone checking or avoidance
cognitive_distortions: Catastrophic Mountain-Building ('This task is impossible and will take forever')
Moralization of Executive Function ('I am just lazy and undisciplined')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Demoralize the struggle: Executive dysfunction is a neurological dopamine routing deficit, not a character flaw or moral weakness.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Vestibular Shake: Stand up, shake your hands, bounce on your heels, and roll your shoulders briskly for 30 seconds to initiate dopamine-norepinephrine motor arousal.
solutions.pranayama: Bastrika (Bellows Breath) Light: Take 10 rapid, rhythmic diaphragmatic breaths followed by a long, slow exhale to break cognitive freezing.
solutions.micro_habit: The 5-Minute Micro-Commitment: Commit to working on the task for exactly 5 minutes with permission to stop immediately when the timer dings.

name: Sleep-Onset Insomnia & Nocturnal Cognitive Rumination
core_symptoms: Inability to fall asleep despite intense physical fatigue
Racing thoughts, problem-solving, or replaying past events in bed
Clock-watching accompanied by escalating dread about tomorrow's exhaustion
Muscular tension and hyper-attunement to ambient sounds
cognitive_distortions: Sleep Catastrophizing ('If I don't sleep right now, my entire day tomorrow is ruined')

solutions.cbt_reframing: De-escalate the performance pressure: Quiet physical rest lying still in bed restores 70% of autonomic energy even without rapid eye movement sleep. Resting is succeeding.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Autogenic Heaviness and Warmth: Mentally repeat: 'My arms are heavy and warm. My legs are heavy and warm. My breathing is calm and regular.'
solutions.pranayama: Dr. Weil's 4-7-8 Breathing: Inhale through nose for 4 seconds, hold breath comfortably for 7 seconds, exhale completely through mouth with whoosh sound for 8 seconds. Repeat 4 cycles.
solutions.micro_habit: The 20-Minute Bed Rule: If awake after 20 minutes, get out of bed in dim light and read a boring physical book until drowsy. Keep bed strictly conditioned for sleep.

name: Health Anxiety & Somatosensory Amplification
core_symptoms: Obsessive checking of pulse, breathing, lymph nodes, or bodily sensations
Compulsive online searching (cyberchondria) for rare medical diagnoses
Misinterpreting normal benign physiological fluctuations as catastrophic disease
Persistent reassurance seeking from loved ones or doctors
cognitive_distortions: Somatosensory Catastrophizing ('This ache in my side is definitely fatal')
Zero-Risk Fallacy ('I cannot rest until I have 100% certainty that I am well')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Attention acts as a somatic amplifier: When you hyper-focus on any bodily organ, sensations multiply by 300%. The sensation is real, but the catastrophic interpretation is false.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Exteroceptive Anchoring: Shift attention 100% outward. Touch 3 different textured external objects, listen to the furthest distant sound, and describe room colors aloud.
solutions.pranayama: Extended Belly Breathing with One Hand on Abdomen: Count to 4 inhaling, 6 exhaling, letting the body's natural autonomic wisdom manage your organs.
solutions.micro_habit: Google Quarantine: Implement a strict 48-hour ban on researching medical symptoms online. If a symptom persists for 2 weeks, consult a physician calmly.

name: Trauma Triggers, Hypervigilance & Nervous System Sensitization
core_symptoms: Sudden emotional flashbacks triggered by sensory cues (tone of voice, scents, postures)
Hypervigilance, exaggerated startle response, and scan for danger
Dissociative numbness or feeling detached from one's physical body
Tight visceral constriction in the throat, chest, or solar plexus
cognitive_distortions: Time Collapse ('What happened in the past is happening right now in this room')
Overgeneralized Danger ('Nowhere and nobody is safe')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Time Orientation Grounding: 'That was then, this is now. My body is sounding an old alarm, but right here in this physical moment, I am safe and the threat has passed.'
solutions.somatic_anchor: Somatic Orienting: Slowly turn your neck to scan the room. Find a solid wall or door, notice the colors, feel your feet firmly planted on the floor, and name 3 things that are stable.
solutions.pranayama: Vocal Vagal Toning: Take a deep inhalation, and on the exhale make a low, steady 'Voooo' sound from your belly. The low frequency vibration signals safety to the dorsal vagal complex.
solutions.micro_habit: Safety Anchor Object: Carry a small, smooth grounding stone or textured item in your pocket. Touch it whenever triggered to re-anchor into the present physical year and room.

name: Intrusive Thoughts, Pure O & Obsessive-Compulsive Rumination
core_symptoms: Distressing, taboo, or repetitive intrusive mental images or doubts
Compulsive mental checking, neutralizing, or endless internal reassurance seeking
Severe anxiety triggered by the fear that having a thought equates to wanting to act on it
Hyper-fixation on uncertainty and inability to tolerate not knowing with 100% certainty
cognitive_distortions: Thought-Action Fusion ('Having this disturbing thought means I am dangerous or secretly desire it')
Need for Absolute Certainty

solutions.cbt_reframing: Exposure & Response Prevention (ERP) / Pratipaksha Bhavana: Thoughts are neurochemical noise, not reflections of character. Agree with uncertainty: 'Maybe that thought is true, maybe it isn't. I am willing to live with uncertainty without performing a mental ritual.'
solutions.somatic_anchor: Passive Observing Posture: Sit upright, open your palms facing upward on your knees, and silently watch the thought drift through the mind like a pop-up ad without clicking or debating it.
solutions.pranayama: Viloma Pranayama (Interrupted Breathing): Inhale with two short pauses, exhale smoothly and continuously for 6 seconds to interrupt obsessive motor loops.
solutions.micro_habit: The 10-Minute Compulsion Delay: When gripped by an urge to mentally check, google, or ask for reassurance, set a timer for 10 minutes and engage your hands in physical work.

name: Caregiver Burnout, Secondary Traumatization & Empathic Strain
triguna_balance: Depleted Ojas, Overextended Rajas into Tamas
core_symptoms: Profound emotional and physical exhaustion from caring for dependents, patients, or struggling loved ones
Emotional numbness or sudden uncharacteristic resentment toward the person being cared for
Persistent guilt when taking personal time or attending to basic self-care
Feeling trapped in an endless cycle of self-sacrifice and chronic responsibility
cognitive_distortions: Omnipotence Fallacy ('If I do not hold everything together, catastrophic harm will occur')
Self-Sacrifice Martyrdom ('My needs do not matter as long as they are suffering')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Equanimity & Differentiated Empathy: You can hold compassion for another without absorbing their emotional suffering as your personal responsibility. Self-preservation is a moral prerequisite for caregiving.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Somatic Shielding Boundary: Place both hands flat against your lower ribs, take a slow breath into your side-body, and feel the physical boundary between your skin and the external room.
solutions.pranayama: Anuloma Viloma with Sattvic Heart Focus: Inhale through left nostril for 4 seconds visualizing replenishing ojas, exhale through right for 6 seconds releasing absorbed fatigue.
solutions.micro_habit: The Non-Negotiable 20-Minute Island: Carve out 20 continuous minutes daily where you are completely off-duty from all caregiving and care-managing tasks.

name: Severe Decisional Conflict, Choice Overload & Ambivalence
core_symptoms: Agonizing inability to choose between options (career, lifestyle, relationship, purchases)
Obsessive pro/con list making and repeated re-evaluation without resolution
Preemptive regret and mourning of the unchosen alternative before even deciding
Paralyzing fear of making an imperfect or suboptimal choice
cognitive_distortions: Maximizing Fallacy ('There is one mathematically perfect choice and any flaw proves I failed')
Catastrophic Regret Overestimation

solutions.cbt_reframing: Satisficing & Two-Way Door Principle: Most decisions are reversible experiments rather than irreversible life sentences. Good-enough action produces more empirical data than endless rumination.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Gut-Body Resonance Test: Hold option A in mind for 60 seconds and observe chest/gut contraction or expansion; then shake out your body and test option B for 60 seconds.
solutions.pranayama: Ujjayi Victorious Breath: Constrict the back of the throat slightly to create an ocean sound on inhale and exhale for 4 minutes to anchor the prefrontal cortex.
solutions.micro_habit: Coin-Flip Intuition Trigger: Flip a coin on a stalled decision; while the coin is in mid-air, notice which outcome your subconscious is hoping lands.

name: Toxic Core Shame, Internalized Defectiveness & Self-Scrutiny
core_symptoms: Visceral sensation of wanting to disappear, shrink, or hide from the gaze of others
Deep-seated belief that one is fundamentally flawed, unlovable, or 'wrong' at the core
Chronic defensive perfectionism or anticipatory social withdrawal to prevent exposure
Intense somatic sinking feeling in the stomach or solar plexus during perceived mistakes
cognitive_distortions: Core Defectiveness ('I am not just someone who made a mistake; I AM the mistake')
Global Negative Self-Labeling

solutions.cbt_reframing: Guilt vs Shame Distinction: Guilt says 'I did something that misaligned with my values.' Shame says 'I am defective.' Separate your fundamental human worth from past actions.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Compassionate Palm-to-Cheek Anchor: Gently cup your own cheek with your warm palm, drop your shoulders, and speak to yourself as you would to a frightened 5-year-old child.
solutions.pranayama: Chandra Bhedana (Left Nostril Lunar Breath): Inhale exclusively through left nostril for 4 seconds, exhale through right for 6 seconds to activate the soothing parasympathetic self-compassion network.
solutions.micro_habit: Daily Unconditional Acceptance Affirmation: Look in the mirror for 10 seconds and say: 'I accept my full humanity, flaws and all, without needing to earn worth today.'

name: Workplace Gaslighting, Mobbing & Institutional Moral Injury
core_symptoms: Severe anticipatory dread on Sunday nights or before work communications
Experiencing gaslighting, credit stealing, subtle exclusion, or hostile management
Self-doubt regarding one's own professional competence and sanity following manipulation
Hyper-arousal, insomnia, and obsessive documentation of work interactions
cognitive_distortions: Internalized Victim-Blaming ('If I were just smarter or tougher, they wouldn't treat me this way')
Stockholm Professional Attachment

solutions.cbt_reframing: Systemic Realignment & Decoupling: Toxic corporate behavior reflects institutional pathology and management dysfunction, not personal inadequacy. Work is a financial transaction, not an identity test.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Boundary Stance Grounding: Stand tall, widen your stance to shoulder width, plant your feet firmly into the floor, and imagine an impenetrable glass barrier between you and toxic demands.
solutions.pranayama: Shitali Cooling Breath with Strong Exhale: Inhale through curled tongue or parted lips, hold for 2 seconds, and exhale forcefully through nose to discharge workplace rage.
solutions.micro_habit: Objective Fact Dossier: Maintain a strictly objective, emotion-free log of deliverables, emails, and dates stored exclusively on personal non-work hardware.

name: Neuroplastic Chronic Pain & Central Somatosensory Sensitization
core_symptoms: Persistent non-structural physical tension, back pain, fibromyalgia, or tension headaches
Hyper-focus on monitoring pain levels and fear of movement or flare-ups
Pain escalates dramatically during periods of emotional stress, anger, or anxiety
Feelings of despair that the physical body is permanently broken or fragile
cognitive_distortions: Structural Catastrophizing ('My spine is ruined and any ache means further tissue damage')
Fear-Avoidance Cycle

solutions.cbt_reframing: Pain Reprocessing Therapy (PRT) / Neuroplastic Understanding: Chronic centralized pain is a miscalibrated brain alarm system signaling perceived danger, not structural tissue damage. The brain learned pain; it can unlearn it.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Somatic Tracking with Lightness: Focus gently on the physical sensation for 30 seconds with pure curious neutrality, like observing clouds in the sky, without trying to fight or eliminate it.
solutions.pranayama: So-Hum Breath of Safety: Inhale silently thinking 'So' (I am), exhale thinking 'Hum' (Whole and safe). Breathe safety directly into the sensitized body part.
solutions.micro_habit: Somatic Joy Movement: Engage in 3 minutes of gentle, unmonitored physical movement (stretching, swaying to music) while deliberately paying attention to parts of your body that feel neutral or comfortable.

name: Cognitive Fatigue, Memory Deficits & Brain Fog
core_symptoms: Working memory lapses, forgetfulness, and word-finding difficulty
Brain fog and sensation of mental fuzziness under stress or fatigue
Difficulty retaining recently learned instructions or recalling details
Executive cognitive fatigue and feeling mentally slowed down
cognitive_distortions: Catastrophic Overgeneralization ('My brain is permanently damaged or declining')
Selective Abstraction (fixating on occasional memory lapses while ignoring normal daily recall)

solutions.cbt_reframing: Normalize working memory limits under stress: Cognitive slips and brain fog are almost always caused by cortisol spikes, sleep debt, or sensory overload occupying mental bandwidth—not permanent neurological decay. Your brain's storage is intact; it is your retrieval bandwidth that is temporarily crowded.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Sensory Focus Re-Anchoring: Take a sip of cold water, feel the sensation as it travels down your throat, and gently tap your temples and forehead with your fingertips for 30 seconds to stimulate prefrontal blood flow.
solutions.pranayama: Brahmi / Bhramari Pranayama (Cranial Resonating Breath): Practice 5 rounds of gentle humming exhalations with your index fingers lightly closing your ear tragus to stimulate cerebral nitric oxide production, calm mental noise, and enhance recall clarity.
solutions.micro_habit: The External Mind Protocol: Free your working memory immediately—never rely on raw mental storage for to-do items. Write everything down on physical paper or a dedicated capture app the moment it enters your mind.
